title: No-Regret Language Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23641v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce no-regret generation, which requires a generator to make a sublinear number of mistakes uniformly over all demonstration sequences and compatible target languages. We also formulate an agnostic variant that allows arbitrary demonstrations that may not be compatible with any languages. For both settings, we introduce tree-based mistake-forcing dimensions that exactly characterize finite-horizon minimax complexity and establish necessary and sufficient conditions for no-regret generation. Our characterizations reveal a rich spectrum of generation rates: up to constant rescaling, every admissible nondecreasing profile is attainable in both the realizable and agnostic settings. Finally, we connect generation complexity to online prediction: for language classes of finite Littlestone dimension \(d\), we obtain realizable mistake bounds of \(O(d\log(1+T/d))\) and agnostic regret bounds of \(O(\sqrt{dT\log(1+T/d)})\). translated_abstract: 我们提出“无遗憾生成”这一概念，它要求生成器在所有示范序列和兼容的目标语言上均匀地产生次线性数量的错误。我们还提出了一个不可知变体，允许使用可能与任何语言都不兼容的任意示范。对于这两种设定，我们引入了基于树的错误强制维度，它精确刻画了有限视野下的极小极大复杂度，并建立了无遗憾生成的充分必要条件。我们的刻画揭示了一个丰富的生成率谱系：在常数尺度调整下，每一种可容许的非递减曲线在可实现和不可知两种设定中都是可以达成的。最后，我们将生成复杂度与在线预测联系起来：对于Littlestone维度为有限值 d 的语言类，我们获得了 O(d log(1+T/d)) 的可实现错误界和 O(√(dT log(1+T/d))) 的不可知遗憾界。
tldr: 本文提出无遗憾生成框架，用基于树的错误强制维度精确刻画生成任务的极小极大复杂度，揭示所有可容许生成率均可达成，并将其与在线预测联系起来，得到由Littlestone维度决定的错误界和遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the no-regret generation framework, exactly characterizes the finite-horizon minimax complexity via tree-based mistake-forcing dimensions, shows every admissible generation rate profile is attainable, and connects generation complexity to online prediction, yielding mistake and regret bounds in terms of the Littlestone dimension.
